description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

The Team: 

This role is to join a "tip of the spear" team that brought Alpaca's ITN to market. We focus on building bleeding edge products that push the envelope for the entire industry. Alpaca's ITN is the world's first and only example of multimodal clearing, we invented the category. You will be joining a winning team that takes products from zero to one in the most authentic sense of the phrase with a track record to prove it. Expectations of excellence and technical competence are extremely high. This is not just any team at Alpaca, this is an elite squad of seasoned serial entrepreneurs with high agency responsible for the very innovations that generate Alpaca's competitive edge.

Your Role:

As Lead Product Manager, Multimodal Clearing, you will define and build a new category of market infrastructure: a multimodal clearinghouse that nets and mitigates settlement failures across the traditional and tokenized forms of the same security, across venues, token standards, and blockchains. Tokenized equities trade in isolated venues today and depend on market makers pre-funding inventory everywhere they quote. You will own the product that brings post-trade settlement, multilateral netting, and in-kind convertibility to onchain markets, so liquidity can move freely between tradfi and defi. The product builds on Alpaca's Instant Tokenization Network (ITN), which already lets participants mint and redeem tokenized equities against their traditional counterparts instantly and 24/7 within Alpaca. Your job is to take that model industry-wide: an open clearing standard and technology layer that licensed clearinghouses use to serve clearing members, broker-dealers, tokenization agents and token issuers, trading venues and ATSs, onchain RFQ and intent protocols, bridges, market makers, transfer agents, and CSDs. You will work hand in hand with clearinghouse leadership, engineering, risk, legal, compliance, operations, and with external partners and regulators. We're looking for someone who knows how clearing really works (novation, netting, margin, collateral, default management, settlement cycles) and how blockchains really work (smart contracts, oracles, vaults, cross-chain messaging), and who can turn a whitepaper into a shipped, regulated product. You are as comfortable walking a clearing member or regulator through a default scenario as you are reviewing a smart contract design with engineers.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Own the product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for the multimodal clearinghouse, from the first live MVP through cross-chain clearing and a fully onchain clearing layer
  • In your first 3 months, ship the first production use case: post-trade settlement for atomic onchain RFQ
  • Within 12 months, extend the backstop to cross-chain bridging and to share-for-token tradfi interoperability
  • Design the clearing mechanics with risk and engineering: a 24/7 settlement cycle, the multilateral netting engine, margin and haircuts for collateral pledged onchain (“in the net”) and offchain (“outside the net”)
  • Define the onchain primitives (portfolio margin vaults, margincoins, claim vouchers, oracle-published netting-cycle signatures) and the open source reference smart contracts, such as RFQ solvers, token deployers, and vault adapters, that partners implement. Own the member and partner experience: onboarding for clearing members, tokenization agents, venues, and protocols; certification of implementations against the standard; APIs, documentation, sandbox, and settlement reporting. Partner with legal and compliance on the regulatory path for clearing tokenized securities in the US and internationally, and translate requirements into product, operational design and go-to-market materials. Run discovery with issuers, broker-dealers, CSDs, venues, market makers, and DeFi protocols, and represent the product credibly in partner, industry, and standards conversations.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Visceral understanding of Clayton Christensen's JTBD Framework and a no nonsense approach to achieving product-market fit. Relentless execution towards this singular goal with no time for fluff or scope creep
  • Demonstrable evidence of shipping products that people want and generating revenue (b2b) or other unit of value (consumer)
  • Deft ability to use AI to produce prototypes instantly
  • Ability to communicate and manage engineers and gain respect amongst peers for technical depth. Command of securities and commodities market structure, especially clearing and what essential function clearinghouses perform. Market microstructure: an unequivocal capability to explain how liquidity flows in capital markets and the nuances of different asset classes and layers of the value chain (custody, brokering, matching, dealing, clearing, settlement). An equal command of tokenization and crypto market structure, specifically tokenized equities, borrow/lending and DEXs, and the differences between execution methods: CLOBs, AMMs, PropAMMs, OTC, RFQ, atomic swaps. Organizational skills bordering obsessive-compulsive. You are the type of person that takes pride in clean and organized presentation materials. Project management skills including running cross-functional projects, status updates, monitoring progress and defining OKRs and building cohort retention charts are bread and butter for you.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Senior ownership of clearing, settlement, or post-trade infrastructure at a clearinghouse, CSD, clearing broker, exchange, or self-clearing broker-dealer
  • Track record of shipping regulated financial products (SEC, CFTC, or non-US equivalents), ideally including clearing agency registration or exemptive relief
  • Built on or with DeFi protocols: lending markets and vaults, RFQ intent protocols and solvers, or perpetual futures venues. Familiarity with derivatives clearing, including perpetual futures and portfolio margining. Experience with industry standards bodies, open source protocols, or consortium governance.
  • Experience working at a startup
  • Experience working remotely and across time zones, async first

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.
